svg.text: Coverage against counted onboarding decisions, under four DECLARED replay mixes
Every mix is a stated assumption: the fixtures carry no traffic distribution.
y is measured by replaying the constructed stream through the runtime; x is counted from the session records, not timed.

g.text: hand-authoring: one decision per field (same coverage)

svg.text: ASSUMED: every corpus line weighted equally
ends at 30.15% of the stream: 60 decisions (ULPF) vs 211 (by hand)
ASSUMED: four sources at 25 % each; within a source, by corpus line count
ends at 24.35% of the stream: 60 decisions (ULPF) vs 211 (by hand)
ASSUMED: four sources at 25 %; 80 % of each firewall's volume is connection/traffic logging
ends at 48.55% of the stream: 60 decisions (ULPF) vs 211 (by hand)
ASSUMED: the demo's own stream: only the nine onboarded families, in the demo's proportions
ends at 100.0% of the stream: 60 decisions (ULPF) vs 211 (by hand)
x: cumulative onboarding decisions (counted; nobody was timed). Nine families, four sources; each dot is one family, in descending volume under that mix.
y: share of the replayed stream emitted as usable events (held-out and in-sample replay agree at every step). A step is a family, not a trend: nine points do not support a fitted curve.
